verdict.rationale: A direct probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://gecko.security/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. It sits alongside a documented v1 API covering scans, vulnerabilities, schedules and webhooks. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that points to or describes the downloadable spec, and confirmation that the spec covers the full v1 API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://gecko.security/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Gecko's v1 API lets you trigger scans, read scan, repository, and vulnerability data, triage findings, manage scan schedules, rotate your GitLab token, and receive webhook events
